title: Opportunity alternatives
purpose: Represent mutually possible actions without encoding preference scoring.

expected.semantic_interpretation: A decision opportunity and alternatives are representable before outcome evidence arrives.
expected.opportunity: Alternatives are explicit strings; no scoring or preference conclusion is stored.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Source identity and capture/procedure provenance remain explicit.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
